company.name: Cluster
company.shortDescription: Cluster is a HealthTech startup digitizing and automating pharmaceutical procurement and distribution across emerging markets.
company.description:
Cluster is building the intelligence layer for the pharmaceutical supply chain — enabling pharmacies, distributors, and suppliers to operate through a unified, data-driven platform.
Through automation and real-time connectivity, Cluster streamlines procurement, reduces inefficiencies, and ensures reliable access to medicines at scale.
The platform has already automated millions of orders, connected thousands of pharmacies, and partnered with hundreds of suppliers — collectively serving over 5 million patients.
Cluster is also tackling one of the most critical challenges in healthcare systems: counterfeit medicine. By enabling transparency and traceability across the supply chain, Cluster enhances trust, safety, and operational efficiency across the ecosystem.
